title: Visual Mode
description: Select first, act second: block selections that edit many lines at once, and pasting over a selection.

intro: Visual mode turns the order around: select first, then act. v selects characters, V whole lines and <C-v> a block, a rectangle down several lines. Move to stretch the selection, then any operator works on it: d deletes, c changes and y copies.
Block selections edit many lines at once. Select a column, press I or A, type once, and <Esc> repeats what you typed on every line of the block.

commands.text: Start a block selection. Move down and across to stretch it.
In a block selection, insert before the block on every line. The other lines get the text when you press <Esc>.
Stretch a block to the end of every line, however long each one is.
In a block selection, append after the block on every line.
Delete the block: the same columns from every line.
Change the block: it's deleted on every line, and what you type goes on every line.
Select characters. iw, i" and the other text objects work here too: viw selects a word.
Put what you copied in place of the selection.

levels.title: Comment it out
levels.description: Four debug logs, zero dignity. Prefix every line with '// ' in one go.
levels.hint: <C-v> starts a block selection. Extend it down, press I, type, and <Esc> copies the insert to every line.

levels.title: Ragged edge
levels.description: The linter wants semicolons. Append ';' to every line, however long it is.
levels.hint: In a block selection, $ stretches every line to its own end. Then A appends after each one.

levels.title: Column cleanup
levels.description: The numbers add nothing. Delete the 'NN ' column from every line.
levels.hint: Select a block three columns wide down all five lines, then d.

levels.title: Block change
levels.description: Production says otherwise. Change every 200 to 503.
levels.hint: The numbers line up in a column: select them as a block and c changes them all at once.

levels.title: Paste over
levels.description: Replace loadPrefs with the real function name from the comment. Typing it is allowed. It is also 43 characters.
levels.hint: Yank the long name with yiw, then select loadPrefs with viw and p pastes over the selection.
